attributes.name: Teraktinus
attributes.powers:
Before the encounter, Teraktinus deals 1d4-1 Ranged Combat damage to you.

Damage dealt by Teraktinus during the checks is dealt to each character at this location.

"You greedy little things crawl all over fields and forests while we scrape what we can from old fires and dust. It's time you learned the taste of ashes."—Raider Teraktinus
